parameters.query:
-- Step 1: Try to link with existing booking from exentia-reserva (no appointment yet)
-- IMPORTANT: subquery with LIMIT 1 to avoid duplicate-key when multiple bookings match
WITH target AS (
  SELECT id FROM exentia.bookings
  WHERE ghl_appointment_id IS NULL
    AND (
      (cliente_telefono IS NOT NULL AND RIGHT(cliente_telefono, 10) = RIGHT($6, 10))
      OR (cliente_email IS NOT NULL AND LOWER(cliente_email) = LOWER($7))
    )
    AND created_at > NOW() - INTERVAL '2 hours'
  ORDER BY created_at DESC
  LIMIT 1
),
link_existing AS (
  UPDATE exentia.bookings
  SET ghl_appointment_id = $1,
      fecha_agendada = $2::date,
      hora_agendada = $3::time,
      duracion_total_min = $4,
      cliente_nombre = COALESCE(NULLIF($5, ''), cliente_nombre),
      cliente_telefono = COALESCE($6, cliente_telefono),
      cliente_email = COALESCE(NULLIF($7, ''), cliente_email),
      servicios = CASE WHEN $8::jsonb != '[]'::jsonb THEN $8::jsonb ELSE servicios END,
      lead_ref = COALESCE($9, lead_ref),
      zona_colonia = COALESCE($10, zona_colonia),
      preferencia_sexo = COALESCE(NULLIF($11, ''), preferencia_sexo),
      atribucion = CASE WHEN $12::jsonb IS NOT NULL THEN $12::jsonb ELSE atribucion END,
      ghl_contact_id = COALESCE($13, ghl_contact_id),
      estado = COALESCE(estado, 'reservo')
  WHERE id = (SELECT id FROM target)
  RETURNING id, booking_code, ghl_appointment_id, fecha_agendada, hora_agendada, 'linked' AS merge_type
),
-- Step 2: If no existing booking matched, insert new
insert_new AS (
  INSERT INTO exentia.bookings (
    booking_code, ghl_appointment_id, ghl_contact_id,
    cliente_nombre, cliente_telefono, cliente_email,
    servicios, fecha_agendada, hora_agendada, duracion_total_min,
    lead_ref, zona_colonia, preferencia_sexo, atribucion,
    estado
  )
  SELECT
    $14, $1, $13,
    $5, $6, $7,
    $8::jsonb, $2::date, $3::time, $4,
    $9, $10, $11, $12::jsonb,
    'reservo'
  WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM link_existing)
  ON CONFLICT (ghl_appointment_id) WHERE ghl_appointment_id IS NOT NULL
  DO UPDATE SET
    fecha_agendada = EXCLUDED.fecha_agendada,
    hora_agendada = EXCLUDED.hora_agendada,
    duracion_total_min = COALESCE(EXCLUDED.duracion_total_min, exentia.bookings.duracion_total_min),
    cliente_nombre = COALESCE(NULLIF(EXCLUDED.cliente_nombre, ''), exentia.bookings.cliente_nombre),
    cliente_telefono = COALESCE(EXCLUDED.cliente_telefono, exentia.bookings.cliente_telefono),
    cliente_email = COALESCE(NULLIF(EXCLUDED.cliente_email, ''), exentia.bookings.cliente_email),
    servicios = CASE WHEN EXCLUDED.servicios != '[]'::jsonb THEN EXCLUDED.servicios ELSE exentia.bookings.servicios END,
    lead_ref = COALESCE(EXCLUDED.lead_ref, exentia.bookings.lead_ref),
    zona_colonia = COALESCE(EXCLUDED.zona_colonia, exentia.bookings.zona_colonia),
    preferencia_sexo = COALESCE(NULLIF(EXCLUDED.preferencia_sexo, ''), exentia.bookings.preferencia_sexo),
    atribucion = CASE WHEN EXCLUDED.atribucion IS NOT NULL THEN EXCLUDED.atribucion ELSE exentia.bookings.atribucion END,
    ghl_contact_id = COALESCE(EXCLUDED.ghl_contact_id, exentia.bookings.ghl_contact_id)
  RETURNING id, booking_code, ghl_appointment_id, fecha_agendada, hora_agendada, 'inserted' AS merge_type
)
SELECT * FROM link_existing
UNION ALL
SELECT * FROM insert_new;
